# QR encoder provenance

Source: `qrcode-generator@1.4.4`, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT.
Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz

Only the final AMD/CommonJS export wrapper is replaced with an ESM default export.
The encoding algorithm is unchanged. The minimal declaration lists the API used
by OA. The server emits SVG locally; there is no external QR image service or CDN.

ESM module SHA-256: `c4bb9d39b0178b08219a820a7a187626ea7fcac90827489d6cb52ecca903ab82`.
